title: Fewer Tokens, More Answers: Verifiable-Reward Tuning of an Ornith-Style VLM for Multi-View Driving QA
abstract: arXiv:2611.00833v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning-enabled model derivatives must turn intermediate deliberation into a usable answer within a deployment budget. We study that transition in an Ornith checkpoint adapted to multi-camera driving question answering with verifiable rewards. Paired archived outputs show that, on a selected 400-question development screen with a 256-token cap, GRPO increases answer extraction from 78.25% to 90.25% and accuracy from 55.50% to 63.75%. Of 39 wrong-to-correct transitions, 33 begin with an unextractable base response. The base's 87 unextractable responses all reach the token cap. Checkpoint-verified reconstruction on those same questions gives a much smaller first-pass accuracy gain at 512 tokens: +0.75 percentage points, versus +8.25 at 256. translated_title: 更少token，更多答案：面向多视角驾驶问答的Ornith风格VLM可验证奖励微调
translated_abstract: 具备推理能力的模型衍生版本必须在部署预算内将中间推理过程转化为可用的答案。我们在一个经可验证奖励适配于多摄像头驾驶问答任务的Ornith检查点上研究这一转化过程。配对的存档输出显示，在选定400道题的开发筛选集、256 token上限下，GRPO将答案抽取率从78.25%提升至90.25%，准确率从55.50%提升至63.75%。在39次由错误转为正确的转变中，有33次源于基座模型原本无法抽取答案的响应；基座模型的87个不可抽取响应全部触及token上限。在同一批问题上的检查点验证重构显示，512 token下的首次通过准确率提升小得多：仅+0.75个百分点，而256 token下为+8.25个百分点。后续基于答案提示的续写被单独分析；它对基座模型的帮助更大，并缩小了适配器带来的差异。在完整的2,511题开发集上，这一带恢复机制的流水线降低了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文用可验证奖励（GRPO）微调Ornith风格视觉语言模型用于多视角驾驶问答，发现在256 token的紧凑生成预算下能显著提升答案抽取率与准确率，且收益主要来自将原本超长、无法抽取的推理输出转化为可用答案。
en_tdlr: Verifiable-reward (GRPO) tuning of an Ornith-style VLM for multi-view driving QA sharply improves answer extractability and accuracy under a tight 256-token budget, mainly by turning unextractable, over-long reasoning outputs into usable answers.
